lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are distributed posterior to the gills, forming a semi-regular grid with primary nodes roughly centered at the mid-lateral flank height.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with primary blobs, creating a faint grid-like structure in the region posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper-lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and low-luminance shadow pixels on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, white, elongated filamentous objects are attached to the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense concentration of micro-luminance spots, significantly smaller and more clustered than those on the main torso.
